title: There Are 2 Eclipses This August. Here’s How to See Them
summary: They include a full solar eclipse on August 12 and a partial lunar eclipse on August 27 and 28. Path: Unlike a solar eclipse, a lunar eclipse does not follow a narrow path across the Earth.
